story: Stage 5 opened at 50 km/h, with a major crash. After the hour a 15-rider breakaway formed. Vermaerke, later joined by Vlasov and Driesen, was eventually reeled in. Pellizzari attacked 1.3 km from the finish to win, while Gall resisted Onley’s pressure and secured the overall classification ahead of Onley and Ciccone.
